drafts.body:
A Reddit user with a setup of two AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX and one RX 7800 XT (totaling 64GB VRAM) shared dated performance observations comparing VLLM and llama.cpp backends for running Gemma3:27b and Qwen3 32B models. Their report suggests differing inference speeds depending on the backend, but with limited and specific hardware conditions from mid-2025.
